searchText: To me it seems like the opposite is the case. When you leave it up to chance who your peers are you are giving an attacker the option to eclipse you 🤔 it takes a bit of effort so there is no incentive to attack most nodes. but something like infura might be a target 😛 it would be interesting to learn about their mitigation strategies but i guess that is outside the scope of this server tbh.
